fusions.name: Burrowed Thorn
fusions.desc: A thorn jab that deals 4 damage, poisons the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it 4% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Seed Pods
fusions.desc: Looses 3 seed pods at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage and stunning the target for 0.8 seconds. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Caged] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Quiet Browse
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Green Recovery
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
